messages:
anna_prod: Heads-up — planning a coordinated announcement for the LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors + GateHub gateway integration and Orchestrator tooling. Need to align marketplace listing, HW partner embargo, and SI enablement. Proposed timeline: draft assets by Tue (48h), internal review Wed, canary demo on Dedicated Thurs, external announce in 2 weeks. Any blockers?

mike_pm: Sounds good. timeline ok from PM side but we need explicit SI partner signoff for the demo. tagging @jess_ops for operational constraints.

jess_ops: FYI infra has one caveat: Dedicated capacity autoscale needs a config tweak for the demo (burst policy + warm nodes). Can we push external announce by 3 days if that helps avoid risk? Also marketplace vendor onboarding requires completed billing contact form.

liam_eng: Quick dev note — LangChain adapter needs a tiny API bump for tool-calling semantics; estimate ~2 engineer-days to ship and smoke test. We'll target a canary on prod-dedicated-1.

anna_prod: Ok noted. We prefer to keep the external date if possible for GTM, but safety first — if infra needs +3 days let's plan for that and tell partners ASAP. Action items: (1) liam — api bump ETA by EOD tomorrow, (2) jess — confirm autoscale change and time estimate, (3) mike/sarah — legal/partner embargo windows.

sarah_legal: We can support the embargo. Please share the joint press draft 48h before external and the partner logos list for trademark checks. Also need to know whether HW partners have a publicity blackout — ask them to confirm.

mike_pm: I'll ping the SI and HW partners this afternoon with the proposed timeline and ask for formal embargo confirmation.

deploy_bot: [deploy scheduled] canary job queued for prod-dedicated-1 at 2024-07-11T16:30Z — results will be posted in #eng-runtime.

anna_prod: Great — I'll update the partner-facing timeline and circulate a short checklist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

liam_eng: ETA on API bump: tomorrow noon PST. Will post a short changelog and test plan.

jess_ops: Autoscale tweak: needs one afternoon of ops time + a dry-run. If we approve now, we can do this Wed morning.

anna_prod: Perfect. I'll sync with Mike to set the embargo ask and share PR draft with @sarah_legal by Tue morning.
